---
title: Home
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        -
          # Ahead of the navbar and sidebar it lets keyboard users skip
          # (bd-rbd3jq4n; Quarto 1 tests/smoke/site/render-skip-link.test.ts).
          # Not anchored to `body >`, which the hub preview's `#root`
          # wrapper breaks (bd-21n09dwj); the sibling selector still
          # pins the link ahead of the header in both DOMs.
          - 'a#quarto-skip-link[href="#quarto-document-content"]'
          - 'a#quarto-skip-link ~ header#quarto-header'
          - 'main#quarto-document-content[tabindex="-1"]'
        - []
---

A website page with a navbar and a docked sidebar.
